news.title: UN holds annual vote on condemning US embargo on Cuba as tensions spill into public
news.summary: The United Nations is set to vote on a resolution condemning the decades-long U.S. economic embargo on Cuba as the Trump administration intensifies its campaign to undermine Cuba’s socialist government
